# Synthetic document fixtures

These project-created documents contain no private course material, credentials, or model output. Multilingual text is intentional coverage for Unicode, font rendering, and exact source preservation.

| File | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| sample.docx | Unicode text, code, repeated paragraphs, a 65-row table, and page breaks |
| sample.pptx | Three slides, a hidden slide, and speaker-notes markers |
| sample.doc / sample.ppt | Corresponding binary Office formats and converted-page locations |

PPTX and binary Office files were exported with LibreOffice. They test conversion and mapping, not universal format or model quality. See [Testing](../../../docs/testing.md).
